posts.text: During a congressional testimony under oath, secretary of commerce Howard Lutnick admitted to Congress that the United States government had only approved one application for the gold card visa program launched by Trump last year. The program started accepting applications in December 2025 and Lutnick had boosted about tens of thousands of applications haven’t been received so far.  The program allows for a nationals to receive a green card after investing $1 million.

A Virginia circuit court judge has issued an emergency injunction, blocking the implementation of the new congressional district maps approved by voters in Virginia after the referendum on April 21 Judge Jack Hurley Junior, of Tazewell County, argued that the referendum did not follow the proper constitutional procedure and that every ballot cast is therefore invalid.  The decision will be quickly appealed by the state of Virginia.
